_comment: Heterogeneous FireSim schedule: periodic dronet (period=200ms) + non-periodic yolov8_nano on the dual-rocket-saturn-gemmini bitstream. cpu_p is the gemmini-accelerated rocket (target=firesim_rocket_saturn, hw=gemmini, topo_0); cpu_e is the saturn-RVV-only rocket (hw=RVV, topo_0). The cpu_p/cpu_e naming follows the scheduler's convention (run_xpurt_schedule.py reads profile_hw["cpu_p"] / profile_hw["cpu_e"]); cpu_p here is just the gemmini-equipped rocket regardless of clock — the dual-rocket-saturn-gemmini bitstream has identical rocket cores, only the accelerator attachment differs. Profile data comes from agents/examples/multi_demo/.../sweep_v8 — see zephyr-chipyard-sw/agents/notes/firesim_sweep_v8_results.md for the methodology. dronet and yolov8 are int8; the gemmini conv2d_s8 path uses tiled_conv_auto with the gemmini_fence() drain fix.
